capabilities: Sync vault folders with external local folders bidirectionally
Resolve conflicts with configurable strategies (newer wins, Obsidian wins, project wins, ask)
Auto-sync on change, startup, or a schedule
Preview pending changes with a dry-run before syncing
disambiguation: Not an AI agent integration; it only syncs folders, with AI coding tools acting as outside writers of the docs.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It is positioned for solo workflows only; team collaboration is deferred to the related Team Relay Sync plugin. Troubleshooting lives in an external docs/Troubleshooting.md.
motivation: The author built it for AI-assisted coding workflows, after seeing AI hallucinate from outdated specs and docs go stale between repo and vault.
problem: Obsidian specs and a codebase's /docs drift apart when AI tools or teammates edit one side, causing stale AI context and manual copy-paste.

relations.evidence: If you need team collaboration or want to publish your vault as a website

summary: Bidirectional file sync that mirrors a vault folder with an external project docs folder, keeping AI-updated repo docs and Obsidian notes current.
